annotations.description: The player chose to mulligan a very keepable 7-card hand. The hand has 5 lands (4 Swamps + Thriving Moor), Devouring Swarm (a solid 3-drop), and Skullslither Worm (a strong 4-drop). While the hand is land-heavy, it has a clean curve of turn 3 Devouring Swarm into turn 4 Skullslither Worm (which forces a discard). The Thriving Moor can even choose green if needed for later splashes. Going to 6 cards means losing a card for no good reason — this hand functions perfectly well and has two quality spells on curve. Land-heavy hands are much better than land-light hands, and mulliganing to 6 in limited is a significant cost.
annotations.actionTaken: Mulliganed a 7-card hand with 5 lands, Devouring Swarm, and Skullslither Worm.
annotations.betterLine: Keep the 7-card hand. Play Devouring Swarm on turn 3, Skullslither Worm on turn 4, and draw into more spells with the extra card.

annotations.description: Put the only land in hand (Thriving Moor) on the bottom of the library, leaving a 5-card hand with zero lands. All spells in hand cost 2+ mana, with most costing 3-5 mana. With no lands, the player cannot cast anything and must draw multiple lands before becoming functional, which is devastating after already mulliganing to 5.
annotations.actionTaken: Put Thriving Moor on the bottom, keeping a zero-land hand of all spells.
annotations.betterLine: Bottom Rise Again (expensive, situational 5-mana sorcery that needs a creature in graveyard) or Grotesque Mutation (reactive combat trick) instead, keeping the only land to have a chance at curving out.

annotations.description: Bottomed a Swamp instead of Massacre Wurm, leaving only 2 lands in a 5-card hand. While Massacre Wurm is powerful, at 6 mana (3BBB) it's extremely expensive and the player needs to draw multiple lands in a row just to cast their 3-drop on time. A 2-land, 5-card hand is very risky in Limited.
annotations.actionTaken: Bottomed a Swamp, keeping a 2-land hand with Massacre Wurm (6 mana)
annotations.betterLine: Bottom Massacre Wurm to keep 3 Swamps, ensuring on-curve Liliana's Devotee on turn 3 and Strangling Spores on turn 4. Massacre Wurm is too expensive to justify keeping in a mana-light mulligan hand.

annotations.description: Playing Forest instead of Thriving Heath on turn 1 when there's no 1-mana play available. The tapped land should be played when the tempo cost is free (turn 1 with no 1-drop). Both lines work for the curve, but playing Heath now choosing green would give flexible mana while 'wasting' the enters-tapped downside on a turn where no mana is needed.
annotations.betterLine: Play Thriving Heath (choosing green) turn 1, taking advantage of having no 1-drop to absorb the enters-tapped tempo loss for free

annotations.description: Playing Plains instead of Thriving Heath on a turn where neither enables a cast. Thriving Heath enters tapped, making this the ideal turn to play it (no spells castable with 3 mana anyway). Saving Plains for a later turn when entering untapped matters is better sequencing. Additionally, Thriving Heath (choosing green) provides more color flexibility than Plains.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Plains (enters untapped but can't use the mana productively this turn)
annotations.betterLine: Play Thriving Heath (choosing green) now while you can't cast anything anyway, saving Plains for a turn where entering untapped enables an on-curve play

annotations.betterLine: Attack with Ironshell Beetle for 2 unblocked damage.

Blue is useless for this deck.

annotations.description: MiniMx declined to attack with Liliana's Devotee (2/3) and Zombie Token (3/2) into only two 2/2 vigilance creatures. In every scenario, attacking is superior: if blocked, both MiniMx creatures survive (3 toughness and 2 toughness vs 2 power) while killing the opponent's 2/2s, reducing next turn's incoming damage. If unblocked, 5 damage pushes the opponent from 18 toward a more manageable life total. Additionally, killing creatures triggers Liliana's Devotee end-step ability for a free zombie token. Not attacking preserves the opponent's board unnecessarily when MiniMx is behind at 6 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to attack with any creatures.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with both Liliana's Devotee and Zombie Token. They win every combat trade against the 2/2 vigilance blockers, clearing the opponent's board of those threats while MiniMx's creatures survive, and potentially triggering Devotee's end-step zombie creation.
